changes: Fixed VR autoload when starting Outlast through Steam or OLGame.exe.
Added a recordable desktop view copied from the existing VR render.
Removed the extra empty game window from the desktop and Alt-Tab.
Removed player reach animations and scripted camera movement when opening ordinary hinged doors.
Added an F10 settings menu for effects, body-follow and pickup reach.
Added visual body-follow with a configurable small-glance deadzone.
known_issues: Locked and scripted doors keep their original interactions; the new ordinary-door behavior still needs headset playtesting.
Physical camcorder controls remain experimental and are off by default.
Some scripted grabs and effects can still feel off; extended campaign and headset/runtime checks remain incomplete.
